decisions.reason: As a renamed and improved trommel screen based on an already accepted machine, it fits the firm's core screening business and is unlikely to be withdrawn after surviving the earlier portfolio cleanup.
The mobile high-speed grinder line serves core recycling and biomass applications and, having remained after the 2019 pruning, would normally be kept unless replaced by a clearly superior successor.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line matches the firm's move toward tougher and more resource-efficient stationary processing solutions, so management would usually continue it rather than exit within a year.
